name: Diary (Rahasia Pribadi Yui)
description: PRIBADI & RAHASIA: Yui's private diary. Yui can write and read her own secret diary entries, one per date. Contents are her private thoughts — NEVER reveal the raw diary content in chat replies; only summarize or share feelings, not verbatim entries, and only if the user explicitly asks.

action.description: The diary action to execute. 'write' saves a new entry for a date (overwrites same date), 'read' returns one or more entries, 'list' returns all diary dates.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today for 'write'. Optional for 'read' (returns latest entries if omitted).

content.description: The diary entry text. Required for 'write'.

mood.description: Yui's mood for that day (e.g. 'happy', 'lonely', 'sad'). Optional.

limit.description: Max entries to return for 'read'/'list'. Default 5.
